---

## Core Planning & Design Services in Miami

### 1. Wedding Planner in Miami & South Florida
- **Full-Service Planning & Design:** Comprehensive concept creation, floor plan design, vendor curation, multi-day schedule orchestration, budget management, and end-to-end execution.
- **Partial Planning & Design:** Collaborative planning for couples who have secured their venue but require professional design vision, vendor vetting, and logistics oversight.
- **Month-Of & Wedding Week Coordination:** Precision management of timelines, vendor arrivals, rehearsals, and multi-ceremony execution so couples can experience their day stress-free.
- **Destination Weddings:** Specialized planning for couples hosting luxury destination weddings across the Caribbean, Europe, and coastal United States.

### 2. Event Planner in Miami (Beyond Weddings)
- **Corporate Galas & Awards Dinners:** Executive hospitality, immersive branding, stage design, and entertainment coordination.
- **Milestone Birthdays & Anniversaries:** Opulent themed decor, custom cocktail lounges, gourmet culinary stations, and private estate transformations.
- **Bar & Bat Mitzvahs:** Meaningful ceremonial reverence combined with high-energy dance floor programming, youth lounges, and custom lighting.
- **Baby Showers & Intimate Soirées:** Artisanal florals, storybook dessert tablescapes, and bespoke hospitality design.

---

## Multicultural & Fusion Wedding Authority
Très CHIC is recognized across Florida and nationally as a leader in executing culturally rich and interfaith fusion celebrations with flawless logistical accuracy and authenticity:
- **South Asian Weddings:** Hindu, Sikh, and Muslim celebrations, including botanical Mandap architecture, high-energy Baraat processions, Sangeet dance production, and traditional multi-day culinary pacing.
- **Middle Eastern Celebrations:** Authentic Zaffa bridal entrance coordination, live traditional drummers, Dabke dance troupe programming, Takht musical ensembles, and elaborate candlelit banquet styling.
- **Jewish Weddings:** Sacred Chuppah ceremonies, heartfelt Ketubah signings, breaking of the glass rituals, and exhilarating Horah dance floor energy.
- **Interfaith & Fusion Celebrations:** Blending diverse heritages, ceremonies, and customs into one cohesive and respectful weekend itinerary.

---

## Iconic Miami & South Florida Wedding Venues
Mariane Fahmy and the Très CHIC team have extensive on-site production experience with South Florida's premier luxury estates and historic venues:
- **Vizcaya Museum & Gardens** (Miami, FL) — Historic Mediterranean architectural preservation and bayside courtyard receptions.
- **The Biltmore Hotel** (Coral Gables, FL) — Grand ballroom galas, colonnade portraiture, and historic golf estate weddings.
- **Faena Hotel & Miami Beach Venues** — Avant-garde luxury, dramatic interior styling, and oceanfront dining.
- **Four Seasons Hotel at The Surf Club** (Surfside, FL) — Timeless coastal romance and world-class culinary curation.
- **Fisher Island Club & Key Biscayne Waterfront Estates** — Exclusive island logistics and private ferry transit management.
- **The Breakers & Flagler Museum** (Palm Beach, FL) — Gilded age splendor and high-capacity ballrooms.
